correctness.rationale: The subgroup gcd formula reconstructs exact independent edges and triangles and rules out larger faces. An explicit spanning tree plus triangle fillings kill the core fundamental group; exact integral Euler characteristics give its free second homology, and the simply connected homology Whitehead theorem yields a sphere wedge. Remaining graph edges contribute the exact number of free loops. Four finite reconstructed examples verify the face classification, upper dimension and mod-two Betti ranks.
